updates.title: Updates
updates.autoCheck: Check for updates automatically at every launch
updates.privacyNote: At every launch, sends only your IP address to GitHub. Never any meeting data.

interfaceLanguage.title: Interface language
interfaceLanguage.label: Language of the app’s menus and labels

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.helper: Optional. Summaries are written on this PC by the model you pick; a smaller one uses less memory. You can also skip it and use the exported transcript with another tool.
summaryModel.label: Model used to write summaries

guidelines.title: General guidelines
guidelines.helper: Free-text instructions added to every generated summary, unless a per-request draft turns them off.

storage.title: Meetings storage
storage.moveExisting: Move existing meetings to the new location
storage.moveNote: Existing meetings move from {{path}} to the chosen location.
storage.stayNote: New location starts empty — existing meetings stay in {{path}} (nothing deleted or merged).
storage.restartRequired: Location changed — restart the app to use the new location.

export.title: Markdown export
export.off: Off — choose a folder to export meetings automatically
export.note: Each meeting is written there as one Markdown file (title, date, speakers, then timestamped lines) as soon as its transcript is ready, and refreshed when speakers or summaries change.
